en: I had a meal with the principal,
and the principal told me:
"Pastor, I've been principal here
for two years now,
and it's made me rethink education."
Their own kids were top students,
raised to be leaders in society
and in faith.

text:
"근데 우리 애들 내가 봐도
*이기적*입니다 자기만 알아요"
en: "But even I can see my kids are selfish. They only know themselves."
But the kids here are different.
So I asked, "How are they different?"
"Their energy is sky-high.

text:
*핸드폰*도 안 하고 하니까
에너지 레벨이 높아서
en: No phones, so they're full of energy.
Pastor, these kids
go looking for their own studies.
They don't study like they're being dragged."
Look at teenagers: all dragged along.
Look at the kids coming to the cram schools here.

text:
아침부터 정말
에너지 충만해서 오는 애들은
en: Kids who show up in the morning full of energy?
There are none.
On the way back, I repented a lot.

text:
나는 일반 고등학생처럼
*목회*하고 있는 거 아닌가
en: Am I pastoring like it's ordinary high school?
Told to read the Bible, you read it grudgingly;
told to do homework, you do it grudgingly.
Not that kind of energy.
Love has to be planted.
I don't push discipleship training hard.
Instead, I wait.
Once love is planted,
you do it with tremendous passion.
That's what we need. That's real faith.
